overview.startPoint: Find scribbled notes while raiding the 30-35 abandoned floors of Daemonheim, then ask Skaldrun south-west of the Daemonheim entrance to share their story.

questReqs.text: Find and free Skaldrun from the frozen floors in Daemonheim

notes: Note: This guide is for 100% completion and to receive the unabridged tome. There are other tasks that can be completed but are not required.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

items.html: Ring of kinship to find scribbled notes
items.text: Ring of kinship to find scribbled notes

blocks.html: Find the scribbled note while raiding the 30-35 Abandoned 2 floors of Daemonheim, and recover memory of it.
blocks.text: Find the scribbled note while raiding the 30-35 Abandoned 2 floors of Daemonheim, and recover memory of it.

blocks.html: Talk to Skaldrun and ask him to tell you a story.
blocks.text: Talk to Skaldrun and ask him to tell you a story.

substeps.html: You need to bank everything, including the ring of kinship.
substeps.text: You need to bank everything, including the ring of kinship.

substeps.html: If the option to start this saga is not available, that means you haven't found the scribbled note on the floor inside Daemonheim.
substeps.text: If the option to start this saga is not available, that means you haven't found the scribbled note on the floor inside Daemonheim.

blocks.html: Kill Stomp like you would in a normal dungeon.
blocks.text: Kill Stomp like you would in a normal dungeon.

blocks.html: As Thok, continue down the ladder and kill The Thing with eyes.
blocks.text: As Thok, continue down the ladder and kill The Thing with eyes.

blocks.html: Continue east and exorcise dark spirit to the east.
blocks.text: Continue east and exorcise dark spirit to the east.

blocks.html: Kill the 2 enemies in the next room and continue south.
blocks.text: Kill the 2 enemies in the next room and continue south.

blocks.html: Kill the 3 enemies in the next room and continue east.
blocks.text: Kill the 3 enemies in the next room and continue east.

blocks.html: Pick up the silver curvy thing to the southeast and return back to the starting room to unlock the silver wibbly thing.
blocks.text: Pick up the silver curvy thing to the southeast and return back to the starting room to unlock the silver wibbly thing.

blocks.html: Activate the big rock and kill all the squishy ghosts until the monolith is fully charged then continue north.
blocks.text: Activate the big rock and kill all the squishy ghosts until the monolith is fully charged then continue north.

blocks.html: Head west and kill the coward with a bow.
blocks.text: Head west and kill the coward with a bow.

blocks.html: Once he has been killed, run back to the room where the Silver curvy thing was found (marked by the summoning icon on the minimap).
blocks.text: Once he has been killed, run back to the room where the Silver curvy thing was found (marked by the summoning icon on the minimap).

blocks.html: Next, continue through the rooms to the east, north and east again.
blocks.text: Next, continue through the rooms to the east, north and east again.

blocks.html: Take the Red block from the floor.
blocks.text: Take the Red block from the floor.

substeps.html: If additional food is required, Crunchy rune rocks can be acquired from the supply table.
substeps.text: If additional food is required, Crunchy rune rocks can be acquired from the supply table.

blocks.html: Run back through the rooms: west, south, and 2 more rooms west.
blocks.text: Run back through the rooms: west, south, and 2 more rooms west.

blocks.html: Enter the southern door, then go west by unlocking the red wibbly thing.
blocks.text: Enter the southern door, then go west by unlocking the red wibbly thing.

blocks.html: Attempt to imbue the tiles 3 times. On the third try, Thok will manage to imbue all the tiles correctly.
blocks.text: Attempt to imbue the tiles 3 times. On the third try, Thok will manage to imbue all the tiles correctly.

blocks.html: Take the blue pointed thing in the northwestern corner of the room.
blocks.text: Take the blue pointed thing in the northwestern corner of the room.

blocks.html: Go into the next room with the bulky warrior. Kill him and move out of the direction he is facing if he prepares to charge.
blocks.text: Go into the next room with the bulky warrior. Kill him and move out of the direction he is facing if he prepares to charge.

blocks.html: Once the bulky warrior has been defeated, return to the room with the summoning icon indicated on the minimap.
blocks.text: Once the bulky warrior has been defeated, return to the room with the summoning icon indicated on the minimap.

blocks.html: Unlock the Blue wibbly thing.
blocks.text: Unlock the Blue wibbly thing.

blocks.html: Upon entering the room, take a pickaxe from the rock and equip it.
blocks.text: Upon entering the room, take a pickaxe from the rock and equip it.

blocks.html: Attack the Armoured cow thing until its armour is destroyed.
blocks.text: Attack the Armoured cow thing until its armour is destroyed.

blocks.html: Continue the fight with Thok's sword.
blocks.text: Continue the fight with Thok's sword.

blocks.html: After the fight, go back to the room with the supply table (North-East side).
blocks.text: After the fight, go back to the room with the supply table (North-East side).

blocks.html: In the room to the north, kill the Ramokee skinweaver first, then move on to killing the other ramokees.
blocks.text: In the room to the north, kill the Ramokee skinweaver first, then move on to killing the other ramokees.

blocks.html: Moving to the next room, talk to Thok-blocker until it allows you to enter the room.
blocks.text: Moving to the next room, talk to Thok-blocker until it allows you to enter the room.

blocks.html: Pick up the Orange stick thing in the southeast corner of the room, and return to the room to the east.
blocks.text: Pick up the Orange stick thing in the southeast corner of the room, and return to the room to the east.

blocks.html: Unlock the Orange wibbly thing to face Gobby demon.
blocks.text: Unlock the Orange wibbly thing to face Gobby demon.

blocks.html: Thok should be able to kill the demon before any of its attacks are used. However, if portals appear on the ground, move away from them and continue attacking.
blocks.text: Thok should be able to kill the demon before any of its attacks are used. However, if portals appear on the ground, move away from them and continue attacking.

blocks.html: Go back through the door and take the door to the west.
blocks.text: Go back through the door and take the door to the west.

blocks.html: Kill Warped Gulega. Avoid the 1 lifepoint attack by moving 1 square away when tentacles appear on the ground.
blocks.text: Kill Warped Gulega. Avoid the 1 lifepoint attack by moving 1 square away when tentacles appear on the ground.

blocks.html: Talk to Pretty Lass.
blocks.text: Talk to Pretty Lass.

blocks.html: Kill the Walking ice cube.
blocks.text: Kill the Walking ice cube.

substeps.html: Every 33% damage dealt it will encase itself in ice and running around the dungeon will avoid the player from being hit.
substeps.text: Every 33% damage dealt it will encase itself in ice and running around the dungeon will avoid the player from being hit.

blocks.html: Saga complete!
